atoms.name: Half and full adders
atoms.one_line: Sum = A ⊕ B ⊕ Cin; carry = AB + Cin(A ⊕ B); a full adder is two half adders plus an OR.

atoms.name: Ripple-carry adder delay
atoms.one_line: The carry passes through every stage, so delay is linear in n; the worst case is a carry that propagates everywhere.

atoms.name: Carry lookahead
atoms.one_line: G = AB, P = A ⊕ B, C(i+1) = Gi + Pi·Ci; every carry is a two-level AND-OR, so delay is constant (log n with fan-in 2).

atoms.name: Add/subtract and overflow
atoms.one_line: A − B = A + not B + 1; signed overflow is same-sign inputs with opposite-sign sum, V = C(n−1) ⊕ Cn.

atoms.name: ALU structure and flags
atoms.one_line: An ALU selects among adder and logic outputs and reports N, Z, C, V; signed A < B is N ⊕ V.

atoms.name: Booth multiplication
atoms.one_line: Pair (qi, qi−1): 10 subtract, 01 add, 00/11 shift only; arithmetic right shift keeps the sign.

atoms.name: Floating-point arithmetic
atoms.one_line: IEEE single: 1/8/23 bits, bias 127; add = align, add, normalize; multiply = add exponents (minus bias), multiply significands.
